g.desc: 1. Function: Master SPI001; CFGBVS=GND. Bank0/JTAG and its pulls use1.8V.

g.text: Bank14 and ASIC banks stay1.5V. PROGRAM_B and INIT_B have separate reset outputs.

g.desc: Bank14 and ASIC banks stay1.5V. PROGRAM_B and INIT_B have separate reset outputs.

g.text: C59=47uF is directly wired to the shared Bank0/AUX1.8V supply bus.

g.desc: C59=47uF is directly wired to the shared Bank0/AUX1.8V supply bus.

g.text: 1. Function: Route eight-ASIC recording/control through two direct 60-contact J1/J2 mezzanines.

g.desc: 1. Function: Route eight-ASIC recording/control through two direct 60-contact J1/J2 mezzanines.

g.text: J1/J2.30 are GND; J1.60 protected VIN_3V3 and J2.60 reserved analog stay isolated on LDO.

g.desc: J1/J2.30 are GND; J1.60 protected VIN_3V3 and J2.60 reserved analog stay isolated on LDO.

g.text: The 116 active digital contacts and FPGA bank supplies are preserved from V52.

g.desc: V53 J1.1-60 -> J1.1-60; V53 J1.61-120 -> J2.1-60; no R/C values or electrical nets changed.

g.text: Two rigid DF40C-60DS mate directly to60DP at1.5mm; simultaneous mating/tolerances remain unqualified.

g.text: Only2GND contacts inherited; SI,return density,timing,loading and assembly fixtures require review.

g.desc: 1. Function: Y2 supplies a separate25MHz PL clock to U1.N3(SRCC,bank34,LVCMOS15).

g.text: L3 filters1.5V; C88=100nF bypassesY2; R44=33R damps output; pin1 NC.

g.desc: L3 filters1.5V; C88=100nF bypassesY2; R44=33R damps output; pin1 NC.

g.desc: Y1 remains the125MHz differential GTP reference. Firmware must declare both clocks.

g.desc: 1. Function: Generate VCCAUX_1V8 after core PG; PG_AUX_1V8 enables U4 and U13. C12/C13=22uF.
